description: Internal part of TmGantt (hidden from the editor): the read-mostly overlays of the mobile container (decision G2) — the "More" sheet of the mobile action bar (zoom, task panel, history, reports, view settings; never export / import / mapping), the minimal add-task sheet (name, start, end), the read-only history sheet and the limited long-press menu (Status / Percent / Add task only). They render as siblings of the chart root, like every Gantt overlay. Place TmGantt, not this component.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The TmGantt this part belongs to. Internal: TmGantt places the part itself; a host never does.
